Developed from [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] technology, the '''Gungan personal energy shield''' was a handheld [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energy shield]] employed by members of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to defend against both physical attacks and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. These ovoid frames projected a defensive screen of shield energy capable of deflecting blaster bolts back at the shooter and were similar to riot shields used on other systems. Sized to the wearer, the shield was generally about one-and-a-half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and was carried either on the wrist or held in the off-hand.
